snippet.title: Now on Itch: Departure of Darkness
snippet.description:
Departure of Darkness is a classic late-90's style survival-horror game set in a fictional airport in the year 2005.

You play as Emma Reed, arriving at the terminal to pick up her younger brother Jake. With the airport in lockdown and no help coming, Emma must navigate the chaos, find Jake, and lead a growing group of survivors to safety.

Stay quiet as enemies react to sound. Every step, shot, or scream could be your last.

Play the demo!

Itch: https://red-vault-interactive.itch.io/dod

Join us on Discord and Wishlist us on Steam!
